Here’s the concise recap and what I need from you:

Summary
- SPARK-089 requests a regrade from Research Associate (P2) to Senior Research Associate (P3), effective 2026-01-15. The packet includes: E12 (updated scope/responsibilities), E21 (manager justification/impact), and E37 (org chart). You need excerpts to confirm scope expansion, autonomy, impact, and level/market alignment for P3. With those, I’ll produce a 1–2 paragraph justification, bullet highlights, a leveling matrix mapping, and a final recommendation (with risks/dependencies).

Please provide targeted excerpts from:
- E12 (scope/responsibilities)
  - Concrete changes in scope vs. prior role (projects, domains, complexity)
  - Autonomy indicators (ownership, decision-making, ambiguity handling)
  - Technical/functional depth and cross-functional leadership
  - Measurable outcomes or KPIs owned or directly driven
- E21 (manager justification/impact)
  - Business impact (revenue, risk, throughput, quality, cycle time, stakeholder satisfaction)
  - Evidence of operating at P3 behaviors (mentoring, strategy input, influencing without authority)
  - Market/level alignment rationale (internal parity, external benchmarks, comp signals)
  - Risks if not regraded; ramp/readiness evidence; timing rationale for 2026-01-15
- E37 (org chart)
  - Placement of the role relative to other P2/P3s and team leads
  - Span of influence (who they support/mentor; key partners)
  - Any reporting line or scope changes tied to the regrade

If helpful, you can paste short verbatim snippets plus a brief note:
- Snippet: “Owns end-to-end design and execution of multi-site longitudinal studies; sets methodology and QA standards.”
  - Note: New end-to-end ownership and standards-setting = P3 autonomy/impact.
- Snippet: “Leads cross-functional working group (Clinical, Data Sci, Ops) to prioritize pipeline; decisions accepted org-wide.”
  - Note: Cross-functional influence and decision authority align to P3.
- Snippet: “Reduced study cycle time by 22%; enabled 3 new indications; estimated $1.2M cost avoidance.”
  - Note: Quantified impact for level calibration.
- Org snippet: “Only RA directly supporting 2 program leads; mentors 3 RAs (P1–P2).”
  - Note: Span and mentorship suggest P3 scope.

Once I have those excerpts, I will deliver:
- 1–2 paragraph justification tailored to P3 criteria
- Bullet highlights (scope, autonomy, impact, alignment)
- Leveling matrix mapping (P2 vs. P3 deltas with evidence)
- Final recommendation, risks/dependencies, and any contingencies (e.g., title-only vs. comp timing)

If you prefer, I can share a quick intake template to capture the excerpts.
